// Focal piece: a table on the axis of the French door (15,8..9,12), with seats around it and a lantern hung over it.
// Settee under the windows (z=13), a log sideboard on the east wall with pots, a card table in the south-east corner.
// The stair well x12..13 z20..23 and the chimney masonry at x12/x18 z18..19 stay clear (other parts own them).
import { layers } from "/Volumes/ext1/swe/repos/minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs";

// Floor grid origin [12, 8, 13]: rows run along +z (z=13..23), columns along +x (x=12..18).
const LEGEND = {
  N: ["spruce_stairs", { facing: "north", half: "bottom", shape: "straight" }], // settee: back to the window wall
  W: ["spruce_stairs", { facing: "west", half: "bottom", shape: "straight" }], // chair west of a table
  E: ["spruce_stairs", { facing: "east", half: "bottom", shape: "straight" }], // chair east of a table
  F: "spruce_fence", // table legs
  C: "oak_log", // sideboard
  T: ["spruce_slab", { type: "top" }], // table tops (sit on the fence top)
  P: "potted_poppy",
  Q: "potted_cornflower",
  L: ["lantern", { hanging: "true" }],
};

const LAYERS = [
  // y=8: seating, tables, sideboard
  [
    ".NN.NN.", // z13: settee under the windows, the French door cell (15,13) left clear
    "......C", // z14
    "......C", // z15
    "..WFE.C", // z16: focal table at (15,16), chairs W and E
    ".......", // z17: south side of the table left open
    ".......", // z18: chimney masonry at x12/x18 is not ours
    ".......", // z19
    ".......", // z20: stair well x12..13 is not ours
    ".......", // z21
    "..WFE..", // z22: card table at (15,22)
    ".......", // z23
  ],
  // y=9: table tops, pots on the sideboard
  [
    ".......",
    "......P", // pot on the sideboard (18,9,14)
    ".......",
    "...T..Q", // table top (15,9,16), pot on the sideboard (18,9,16)
    ".......",
    ".......",
    ".......",
    ".......",
    ".......",
    "...T...", // card table top (15,9,22)
    ".......",
  ],
  // y=10: the focal flower
  [
    ".......",
    ".......",
    ".......",
    "...P...", // potted poppy on the table top (15,10,16)
    ".......",
    ".......",
    ".......",
    ".......",
    ".......",
    ".......",
    ".......",
  ],
  // y=11: lanterns hung from the floor above
  [
    ".L.....", // (13,11,14) hanging from the ceiling at y=12
    ".......",
    ".......",
    "...L...", // chandelier over the focal table (15,11,16)
    ".......",
    ".......",
    ".......",
    ".......",
    ".......",
    "...L...", // over the card table (15,11,22)
    ".......",
  ],
];

export function build(g) {
  layers(g, [12, 8, 13], LEGEND, LAYERS);
}

input.summary:
B drawing room furnished in parts/room-6.mjs with layers(): a settee under the windows, a fence-and-slab table with a potted poppy and hanging chandelier on the French-door axis, four chairs and a card table, and a log sideboard with pots on the east wall.
Five hanging lanterns give min light 8 with no dark or dim cells. make.sh gives a whole build.nbt, 23 blocks placed, no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE.
With a temporary entrance at (14,8,19) the walk reaches 63 of 63 floor cells and the room check says OK; the real stair-foot entrance is not in the stub build yet.
left: The real walk verdict is UNREACHABLE only because the stair flight (stairs.mjs, a stub here) and its foot are not merged, and rooms.json's entrance is on the ground floor; the OK above used a temporary rooms file with entrance [14,8,19]. Re-run `mcd room` after the merge to confirm the stair foot connects.
No rug: palette.json has no carpet, so the rug in the design is omitted; no barrels or candles either (log sideboard and lanterns used instead).
The table is spruce_fence at y8 with a top spruce_slab at y9 (type top) and a potted_poppy at y10; the fence-to-slab join is untested in game.
plan.md has no checklist entry or elements.md item for this interior, so nothing was ticked.

waste.what: Worked out the floor cells, chair facings and lane clearance by reading the plan grid by hand, then re-wrote the layer rows after finding an off-by-one row in the lantern layer.
waste.cost: about 3 rebuild/check cycles; one layer-index mistake
waste.tool: `mcd room --only` could print the floor with furniture letters from a layers() legend, or accept a --entrance override so the walk runs before the stair part is merged.

waste.what: Verified reachability by writing a temporary rooms.json with a stand-in entrance, because the real entrance (the stair well) isn't in the build yet.
waste.tool: `mcd walk/room --entrance x,y,z` flag, so a room can be checked against an interim entrance without copying rooms.json.

waste.what: Tried to choose furniture and light from palette.json, which lacks carpets, barrels, candles and beds; the trade brief assumes them.
waste.cost: a few minutes of re-planning the rug and seating
waste.tool: A per-room palette extension (or a palette note listing the interior blocks the trade may use).

companions.task: Confirm the stair flight's foot and landing in the x12..13 z20..23 well, so the room's real entrance can be checked with mcd room before the merge.
Lay a rug and seat cushions, which this palette cannot express: a carpet for the centre and wool for the settee.
Build a proper sideboard and card table from palette woods, replacing the log sideboard and the fence-and-slab table.
